horseshoe.name: An old horseshoe
horseshoe.mara: A horseshoe… I'd hang it over the door, for luck. But luck, it seems, doesn't live in horseshoes. Well, Borta will find a use.

wool.name: A ball of wool
wool.mara: Wool! Still warm, as if just off the sheep. I'll knit someone mittens — our winters are long.

spoon.name: A carved spoon
spoon.mara: What craftsmanship… Someone carved this for their children. I'll keep it safe — maybe the owner will come back.

bead.name: A glass bead
bead.mara: Blue, like the sky when I was a child. Hold it to the fire — see? It glows.
